watch.summary: The streamer laughs upon recognizing a Phil Collins song playing in an elevator before predicting impending trouble in his game.

beats.what: A classic Phil Collins song plays in the game's elevator.
The streamer recognizes the song and bursts out laughing.
The elevator doors open while the streamer drinks water.
In-game dialogue reveals the player character lost his guns.
Streamer casually observes that something bad is about to happen.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The joyful realization of a famous Phil Collins track playing in a video game elevator creates a funny contrast. His casual drinking and ominous prediction right after set a nice relaxed comedic mood.
